newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends little changed,seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends little changed,seen consolidating.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed little changed after trading in a tight range due to lack of liquidity. An absence of fresh developments also dampened activity. The market is likely to consolidate until new leads appear. SGS will release June 1-25 exports on Wednesday. Sept's range seen at 1,180-1,195.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also lacked interest and some scattered business was seen among crude palm oil and selected oils.
At the close, the September futures contract was down two ringgit at 1,188 ringgit ($472.36) a tonne.
"There are no indicators today to guide the market. The next indicator will be the June 1-25 exports figures," the trader said.
Cargo surveyor, SGS (M) Sdn Bhd will release the export data on Wednesday.
Lack of strong consumer buying also limited activity.
Turnover on the futures market was 813 lots.
Physicals saw June (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,230 ringgit against bids at 1,227.50 after trading from 1,220 to 1,227.50.
June (central) saw offers at 1,215 versus 1,207.50 with earlier trades at 1,215 and 1,210.
July (south) was offered at 1,230 against bids of 1,227.50 and July (central) at 1,215 against bids of 1,207.50.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $515 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Aug/Sep at $512.50. Aug was traded at $512.50.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $560 and Aug/Sep at $552.50. Aug was traded at $552.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $395 and Aug/Sep at $390. Aug palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
